phase.text: Not specified; a prospective, planned, pooled analysis of existing study data

citations.quote: Study LA36-0310 was a retrospective selection of a subset of patients from pooled previously conducted studies.

design.text: Single-arm, non-randomized, baseline-controlled pooled analysis of 12 previously conducted studies; patients selected by an Independent Party/Committee by pre-specified criteria.

citations.quote: there are some limitations in the design of the study. These include: that the study was single-arm and non-randomized
Efficacy data in LA36-0310 were derived from 12 of 17 studies.

population.text: Patients with transfusional iron overload (almost all with thalassemia) who had been inadequately treated with other iron chelators (mostly deferoxamine); main chelation-failure criterion serum ferritin >2,500 mcg/L.

citations.quote: The LA36-0310 study population consisted of patients with transfusional iron overload who were inadequately re
they continued to have a serum ferritin in excess of 2,500 µg/L prior to the initiation of deferiprone therapy.

endpoint.text: Primary endpoint: change in serum ferritin from baseline to within one year of therapy; success defined as a ≥20% decline in serum ferritin, with trial deemed effective if ≥20% of patients achieved it.

citations.quote: The primary efficacy endpoint was defined as the change in serum ferritin from baseline to completion of up to one year of therapy.

Patients were considered to have been successfully treated if there was a decline in serum ferritin of at least 20% over that time period and the trial would be deemed to show evidence of efficacy if at least 20% of patients achieved the described efficacy endpoint.

n.text: 264 patients eligible for the primary serum ferritin efficacy analysis

citations.quote: Results: A total of 264 patients were eligible for the primary efficacy analysis.

result.text: Overall success rate for serum ferritin was 52% (95% CI 45%, 58%); 136 (52%) of patients had a ≥20% decrease in serum ferritin; lower CI limit >20% so endpoint met.

citations.quote: The overall success rate for the serum ferritin endpoint was 52% (C.I., 45%, 58%)
A total of 136 (52%) of patients had a 20% or greater decrease in serum ferritin from baseline to end of study.
As the lower limit of the 95% CI is larger than 20%, the protocol defined endpoint was met for this trial.

indication.text: Ferriprox (deferiprone) is an iron chelator indicated for the treatment of patients with transfusional iron overload due to thalassemia syndromes when current chelation therapy is inadequate.

citations.quote: FERRIPROX® (deferiprone) is an iron chelator indicated for the treatment of patients with transfusional iron overload due to thalassemia syndromes when current chelation therapy is inadequate. (1)

target_moa.text: Deferiprone is a synthetic, orally active iron-chelating agent with affinity for ferric ion (iron III); it binds ferric ions to form stable 3:1 (deferiprone:iron) complexes that are excreted, with lower affinity for other metals.

citations.quote: Deferiprone is a chelating agent with an affinity for ferric ion (iron III). Deferiprone binds with ferric ions to form neutral 3:1 (deferiprone:iron) complexes that are stable over a wide range of pH values.
